transcript_only_text:
The  best  revenge  will  always  be  waking 
 up  the  next  morning  as  you,  knowing  that 
 they're  waking  up  the  next  morning  as 
 them.  And  so  succeeding  isn't  the  best 
 revenge,  it's  the  only  revenge.  Because 
 as  you  expand,  they  shrink  into 
 irrelevance.  As  you  get  louder,  no  one 
 can  hear  them.  So  you  don't  really  beat 
 them,  you  cast  a  shadow  so  big  no  one 
 can  see  them  to  begin  with.  And  at  the 
 end  of  the  day,  you  don't  think  about 
 them  either.
